hook: Sebastian Thrun led the Stanford Racing Team that won the 2005 DARPA Grand Challenge, then at Google started the self-driving car project in 2009 that became Waymo, now co-led by Dmitri Dolgov, one of that project's founders. He founded Google X, founded Udacity in 2011 and ran it until its sale to Accenture in 2024, and led the eVTOL company Kitty Hawk. Since August 2023 he has been founder, president and chairman of Sage AI Labs, a stealth startup working on AI and e-commerce.

quick_facts: Founder, president and chairman of Sage AI Labs since August 2023, a stealth startup at the intersection of AI and e-commerce, according to his LinkedIn profile
Adjunct professor at Stanford since July 2003, and led the Stanford Racing Team that won the 2005 DARPA Grand Challenge
Google VP and Google Fellow from April 2007 to August 2014, where he founded Google X in 2009
Founded Udacity in 2011 and led it until May 2024, when it was sold to Accenture, and taught as an adjunct professor at Georgia Tech for its low cost online master's in computer science
Founded Kitty Hawk, an eVTOL company, in 2017, whose flagship team and technology went to Boeing and now operate as Wisk, per his profile
PhD from the University of Bonn, 1995

achievements.title: Stanley wins the 2005 DARPA Grand Challenge
achievements.impact: First autonomous vehicle to complete a 132-mile off-road DARPA course, the breakthrough event for self-driving research.

achievements.title: Founding Google X and the self-driving car project (2009)
achievements.impact: The program became Waymo. His profile also credits him with founding or leading Street View, Ground Truth, Google Glass, Google Brain and Wing, claims this page attributes to him.

achievements.title: Director, Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
achievements.impact: Led one of the world's foremost AI research institutions. His profile describes him as its founding director.

achievements.title: Founding Udacity (2011)
achievements.impact: Built an online education company that he led until its sale to Accenture in 2024.

achievements.title: Research output
achievements.impact: He says he has published more than 400 papers and 12 books, with an h-index of 160. These are his figures. Honorary doctorates from Georgia Tech (2024), Hildesheim (2020), Delft (2016) and the Instituto Politecnico Nacional (2016).
